Lets use the build an app skill and make a tycoon game.

Theme will be Artificial Intelligence tycoon game, starting from a shed and grow to multiple warehouses.
simple click interactions with basic employee sprites, general number go up game
buy hardware, properties and upgrades - progress through a tech tree related to AI Era's
a "singularity event" finishes the game (toggle for competitive mode where an NPC competitor tycoon can cause a loss condition)

## Singularity Foundry is ready

Start in a backyard shed, click through training jobs, hire pixel employees, purchase increasingly powerful hardware, expand into warehouse-scale properties, and progress through six AI eras toward the Singularity.

Competitive mode activates **Omni Mind**, an NPC rival that can reach the Singularity first and end your timeline. Progress autosaves privately and includes capped offline earnings.

[Launch Singularity Foundry](/a/1f86382a-d08c-4a93-bba4-4995b12aff7b)

enhancement.description: AI tycoon from shed to warehouse, with pixel employees, upgrades, and a rival mode where the first Singularity wins.
enhancement.prompt: I want to build an AI tycoon game where I start in a backyard shed, click to grow revenue, hire little employees, buy hardware and properties, and move through an AI-era tech tree until the singularity. I want an optional competitive mode with an NPC rival, plus private autosave and capped offline earnings from local save data.
enhancement.response:
Singularity Foundry is built — an AI tycoon game where you grow from a backyard shed into a full research empire.

- Click to generate the core resource loop, then hire pixel employees to speed up production and keep the numbers climbing.
- Buy hardware, properties, and upgrades to expand from shed to warehouse-scale operations.
- Progress through a tech tree of AI eras, unlocking stronger systems as you advance toward the Singularity.
- Turn on competitive mode to face Omni Mind, an NPC rival that can beat you to the Singularity and trigger a loss condition.
- Progress autosaves privately, and offline earnings are capped so the economy stays balanced.

Open the game and start clicking your first jobs, then reinvest into staff, hardware, and era upgrades as fast as you can.
